dense.control_flow: bounded ascending loop with one filter
dense.composition_order: filter multiples of four, accumulate squared indices
dense.representative_prompt: Read nonnegative n. Sum the squares of positive indices divisible by four up to n, then add 1.
dense.representative_reference:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (i%4==0) { total+=i*i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

diverse.representative_prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers as an array. Add entries at even zero-based positions, subtract entries at odd positions, then add 1.
diverse.representative_reference:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].

fourth_square_step.composition_order: reindex multiples of four, accumulate equivalent squares
fourth_square_step.representative_prompt: Read nonnegative n. Starting at four, visit multiples of four no greater than n. Add each visited index squared, then print the sum plus 21.
fourth_square_step.representative_reference:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=21.
LOOP (NUMBER step=1 TILL 4*step<=n, step++) { total+=16*step*step. }
DISPLAYNL(total).

NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
NUMBER i=0.
LOOP (total<n+21) { i+=1. total+=i*i. }
DISPLAYNL(i).

range_neighbor_mix.composition_order: sum neighbor products, then track extrema, then combine
range_neighbor_mix.representative_prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers as an array. Add the product of each neighboring pair and the array's maximum-minus-minimum range, then add 21.
range_neighbor_mix.representative_reference:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).

DISPLAYNL(total+hi-lo).

positive_run_length.control_flow: indexed loop with nested IF and ELSE reset
positive_run_length.composition_order: carry and reset positive-run length; track maximum segment
positive_run_length.representative_prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers as an array. Find the length of its longest consecutive run of strictly positive entries and add 21.
positive_run_length.representative_reference:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER run=0.
NUMBER best=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>0) { run+=1. IF (run>best) { best=run. } } ELSE { run=0. } }
DISPLAYNL(best+21).
